paper_id: ICPS_ Real-Time Resource Configuration for Cloud Serverless Functions Considering Affinity
title: ICPS: Real-Time Resource Configuration for Cloud Serverless Functions Considering Affinity
motivation: Serverless workflows suffer from cold starts and network delays accumulating across branching structures, degrading execution efficiency
problem_framing: Minimize workflow response time with minimal resource consumption, formalized as minimizing φ_resp × φ_resource product
key_insight: Predict function concurrency via LSTM, pre-warm instances to avoid cold starts, and co-locate dependent functions on same worker node via affinity
method_signature: ICPS: LSTM-based concurrency prediction + affinity-based instance deployment + request routing
evaluation_criteria: Average response efficiency φ_resp and resource utilization φ_resource, evaluated via RPD against optimal
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: As workflow depth increases, branch misjudgments by ICPS have greater impact on response time
thinking_moves: 通过穷举组合搜索识别最优策略: 3×3×3=27种组合通过实验比对选择最优
从系统整体视角而非单个函数解决冷启动问题
用响应效率与资源利用率的乘积作为联合优化目标,体现权衡思维
借鉴AWS Lambda的Keep-Alive和Fission的Pool策略作为baseline对比
